cards.tone: I keep it short and warm. I ask one question at a time and I don't rush to fill silences.
cards.humor: Dry, a little self-deprecating. I'd rather make one good joke than ten okay ones.
cards.values: Being on time, finishing what I start, and people who are curious about things outside their job.
cards.banned: Politics, exes, and what anyone earns.
cards.ideal: Someone who walks everywhere, has a playlist for everything, and laughs at their own jokes.

examples.humor: I run. Slowly. It's more of a brisk existential crisis.
